plain_text:
Grantees should start their data entry in Row 7 of each template. Rows 1-6 should remain
unchanged. Any grantee data entered before row 7 will not be captured by the system and will
also trigger a format validation error. When entering data into the template, grantees should
pay special attention to the information provided in row 4 (expected data type) and row 5
(sample values). Data that do not meet the expected data type may trigger format validation
errors when the grantee attempts to upload a template (see fig. 16).

plain_text:
• String: Except for the fields listed below, string fields may contain any letter,
number, or character (e.g., “This LEA used funds to ...”). Row 4 will indicate the
character limit for the field. Strings should not contain carriage returns.
semantic_text: • String: Except for the fields listed below, string fields may contain any letter, number, or character (e.g., “This LEA used funds to ...”). Row 4 will indicate the character limit for the field. Strings should not contain carriage returns.

plain_text:
○ All UEI Numbers are listed as strings and must be 12 characters long, and
only contain numbers 0-9 and letters A-Z.
○ All DUNS numbers are listed as strings and must be 9 characters long,
and only contain numbers 0-9. When entering data, take care to ensure
that leading 0s in DUNS numbers are not being dropped.
○ All NCES IDs are listed as strings and must be 7 characters long, and only
contain numbers 0-9.

30.25).
